summary: Maelstrom intensities are now four EXCLUSIVE buckets (1 Beginner, 2 Great, 3 Good, 4 Floor; Garrett 2026-11-16) instead of the cumulative pick-up ladder, and the pool is every arcade card (83, was 16). MaelstromDataSO.GamesForIntensity deals only tier N (empty bucket falls back to the whole queue); MaelstromData.asset GameQueue + IntensityTiers are written by Tools/Build/maelstrom_tiers.py from measured flights, launches, git history and verdicts (Docs/MaelstromSystem/INTENSITY_TIERS.md). Cleave is held in the Floor by your run's host-freeze finding. Your multiplayer runs at ceiling 2 now draw only Skim Race (Great has one game).
